b6d8f9da3047891c179408bf937652d24d430b40.summary: IBM X-Force researchers report that Zeus Sphinx, a commercially sold banking Trojan that emerged in August 2015 against UK banks, has been found in Brazil. The Brazilian variant, Sphinx v2, targets online banking and Boleto payment services at three top Brazilian banks and one Colombian bank. It uses real-time webinjections to collect PINs and personal data, and can reroute Boleto payments to the criminal by generating altered barcodes. The malware is sold on underground forums. b6e202c30219866cbf7e8d5dbf937f7dc7435476.summary: US Justice Department press release, published 2023-12-18, announcing a disruption campaign against the ALPHV/Blackcat ransomware group. It says the group has targeted more than 1,000 victims, that it is the second most prolific ransomware-as-a-service variant, and that ransoms totalling hundreds of millions of dollars were paid. The FBI built a decryption tool that helped over 500 affected victims restore systems and saved about $68 million in ransom demands. Foreign law enforcement agencies assisted, and the investigation is described as ongoing. The group uses a multiple extortion model…
